QuestInfo.name: Maintaining Warning Signs
QuestInfo.0: It looks like the Victoria Island Guard has another assignment for you. Talk to #b#p1022007##k in #b#m102000000##k to find out what it is.
QuestInfo.1: #p1022007# says that safety requires taking precautions and asks that you review the information on the warning signs on the #bNorth Rocky Mountain#k. It's been a while since they were checked, so you'll need to fix any mistakes. \r\n\r\n#bCheck the signs located in #m102020100#, #m102020200#, #m102020300#, #m102020400#, and #m102020500##k
QuestInfo.2: You wrote down the monsters displayed in all of the Warning Signs.

0.0: Evan, do you know what a Guard's most important job is? It's to prevent incidents before they happen. To do that, we've posted warning signs throughout #m102000000#.
0.1: It's up to us to keep the signs up to date. Monsters often move around, the sneaky devils, so we have to continually update the signs. It'll be your job to update the information on the signs posted around the #bNorth Rocky Montain#k.

yes.0: It seems complicated but it's not. Simply go find the five Warning Signs located in the section I mentioned and click on them to read them. All you have to do is to fix the mistakes.

no.0: How could you refuse? It's really quite simple... Please rethink your decision.

1.0: Did you finish updating the signs? Great! Anyone in the #m102000000# area will be much more informed. Assuming they can read your handwriting. Still, good job.

yes.0: I'll call on you again if we have more assignments. Like maybe when the monsters go berserk, like #p1040000# mentioned.

default.0: You haven't updated the warning signs yet? Find all 5 Warning Signs located on the #bNorth Rocky Mountain#k. Hop to it, new blood!
default.1: Are you having a hard time because you don't know the geography? Just press the #bW#k key to open the World Map.
